critical_code_review_comments: Note: Banner only appears while React state persists (in-app navigation / browser back). A full page reload of /login triggers checkAuth() → /me returns 401 for pending (no session cookie issued) → user=false → banner hides. This is by design given the backend contract (pending user has no session). Acceptable per spec ('navigasi awal ke /pending boleh terjadi, tapi saat kembali ke /login banner harus tampil').
Consider persisting a lightweight pending marker in sessionStorage if you want the banner to survive hard reloads too — optional enhancement.

rca of the issue: Previously AuthContext.login only setUser on approved. Now: 'else if (r.status === pending && r.user) setUser(r.user)'. Backend /api/auth/login returns {status:'pending', user:{...}} without setting a cookie, so React state carries the pending user while in-memory; on hard reload /me 401s and state resets to false — this is expected.
